Public ZTF alert photometry served by the ALeRCE broker. Cite Förster et al. (2021), AJ 161, 242, and acknowledge ALeRCE and the Zwicky Transient Facility according to current provider guidance.

astro_evidence.projectionMethod: The exporter projects source-native retained rows once; the browser deterministically assembles those measurements with versioned source contracts and persisted receipts.
